name: Recoverable validation failure with preserved answers
summary: When a submission fails, maintain appropriately safe entered answers and provide a path to amend identified errors without unnecessary reentry or dead-end progress.
problem: Lost entered values or uncommunicated validation failure can force rework and block completion.
context: Multi-field forms or services where users retry after input validation fails.
observed_solution: Redisplay safely retainable previously entered data after failure, show errors that identify corrective steps, and allow continued task flow. Treat same-process repeated entry and consequential review as separate scoped concerns.
rationale: GOV.UK validation recovery preserves answers and adds errors (O21/O22); WAI feedback techniques (O17); WCAG 3.3.7 same-process prefill/selection with exceptions (O10), 3.3.4 scoped prevention (O09), and 3.3.1 identification (O06). Do not conflate previously submitted retry values with all prior-process values. No backend persistence or privacy behavior tested.
tradeoffs: Security/privacy may justify clearing sensitive secrets.
Stale data or irreversible scope may require reconfirmation.
Automatic restoration can conflict with user intent if previous data is invalid.
applicability: Recoverable invalid input with non-sensitive answers still usable for correction.
Same-process repeated values where WCAG 3.3.7 applies and no exception is met.
non_applicability: Essential security reentry, no-longer-valid information and deliberately ephemeral secrets.
Cases requiring user-confirmed destructive data action under 3.3.4 are not covered solely by draft preservation.
accessibility_implications: Preserve label/error relationships and meaningful focus/announcement when retrying; not verified in live UI.
responsive_implications: Allow correction and Continue action on narrow screens without lost task-critical navigation.
implementation_notes: No server architecture, storage duration or client validation framework selected.
Do not claim persistence or server-side verification executed.
Classify security exception before restoring sensitive values.

counterexamples.summary: Reentry can legitimately be essential for security or the previous value may no longer be valid.
counterexamples.context: Same-process sensitive authentication or stale data.

version_context: WCAG 2.2 2024; GOV/WAI/USWDS live guidance unpinned; no form persistence observed
